name: BOM Stock Report
query:
SELECT 
	bom_item.item_code as "Item:Link/Item:200",
	bom_item.description as "Description:Data:300",
	bom_item.qty as "Required Qty:Float:100",
	ledger.actual_qty  as "In Stock Qty:Float:100",
	FLOOR(ledger.actual_qty /bom_item.qty) as "Enough Parts to Build:Int:100"
FROM
	`tabBOM Item` AS bom_item 
	LEFT JOIN `tabBin` AS ledger	
		ON bom_item.item_code = ledger.item_code  
		AND ledger.warehouse = %(warehouse)s
WHERE
	bom_item.parent=%(bom)s

GROUP BY bom_item.item_code

name: Debtors Report
query:
SELECT  COALESCE(gsi.name, "TOTAL") AS "Invoice No:Link/Sales Invoice:150",
        if(gsi.name is null, "", gsi.customer) AS "Customer:Link/Customer:250",
        gsi.cost_center AS "Cost Center:Data:250",
        gsi.item AS "Items:Data:300",
		gsi.from_date AS "From Date:Date:100", 
		gsi.to_date AS "To Date:Date:100", 
		gsi.due_date AS "Due Date:Date:100", 
        FORMAT(SUM(gsi.usd),2) AS "USD:Decimal/2:100",
        FORMAT(SUM(gsi.tzs),2) AS "TZS:Decimal/2:100",
        gsi._user_tags as "Remarks:Data:200" 
FROM
(
    SELECT 	si.name, 
    		si.customer,
    		si.cost_center,
    		GROUP_CONCAT(sid.item_name) AS "item",
    		si.from_date,
    		si.to_date, 
    		si.due_date, 
    		si.currency,
        	MAX(IF(si.currency = "USD", IF( si.currency = si.party_account_currency, si.outstanding_amount, si.outstanding_amount/si.conversion_rate), 0)) AS "usd",
    	    MAX(IF(si.currency = "TZS", IF( si.currency = si.party_account_currency, si.outstanding_amount, si.outstanding_amount*si.conversion_rate), 0)) AS "tzs",
    		si._user_tags
    FROM `tabSales Invoice` si LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` as sid ON si.name = sid.parent
    WHERE si.status IN ("Partly Paid", "Unpaid", "Unpaid and Discounted", "Partly Paid and Discounted", "Overdue and Discounted", "Overdue")
    GROUP BY si.name
) gsi
GROUP BY gsi.customer, gsi.name WITH ROLLUP

name: Property Status
query:
SELECT  p.name AS "Property:Link/Property:150",
        p.type AS "Property Type:Data:150",
        p.bedroom AS "BHK:Data:50",
        p.builtup_area AS "Builtup Area:Data:100",
        p.carpet_area AS "Carper Area:Data:100",
        p.unit_owner AS "Unit Owner:Link/Customer:150",
        c.customer_group AS "Owner Type:Data:150",
        l.lease_customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
        l.end_date AS "End Date:Date:100",
        l.lease_status AS "Status:Data:80",
        l.name AS "Lease:Link/Lease:100",
        l.security_deposit_currency AS "Currency:Data:50",
        l.security_deposit AS "Amount:Float:100",
        l.security_status AS "Security Status:Data:100",
        GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT_WS('-',li.lease_item,FORMAT(li.amount,2)) SEPARATOR ' | ') AS "Lease Details:Data:400"
FROM `tabProperty` p left join `tabLease` l on p.name = l.property
                     LEFT JOIN `tabLease Item` li on l.name = li.parent
                  left join `tabCustomer` c on p.unit_owner = c.name
WHERE p.type LIKE concat("%%", IF(%(property_type)s = " " , "", %(property_type)s), "%%")
AND c.customer_group LIKE concat("%%", IF(%(owner_type)s = " " , "", %(owner_type)s), "%%")
GROUP by p.name
ORDER BY p.name

query:
SELECT 	pi.name AS "Invoice No:Link/Purchase Invoice:150", 
		pi.supplier AS "Customer:Link/Supplier:150", 
		GROUP_CONCAT(pid.item_name) AS "Items:Data:200",
		pi.due_date AS "Due Date:Date:100",

name: Self Consumption in Maintenance Job Card
query:
SELECT  jc.name as "Maintenance Job Card:Link/Issue:200",
        jc.property_name  as "Property:Link/Property:200",
        jc.customer  as "Customer:Link/Customer:200",
        jc.opening_date as "Opening Date:Date:120",
        jc.resolution_date as "Resolution Date:Date:120",
        jc.modified_by as "Modified By:Link/User:200",
        jc.status as "Status:Data:120",
        jcmb.item as "Item:Link/Item:200",
        jcmb.quantity as "Quantity:Float:200",
        jcmb.uom as "UOM:Link/UOM:200",
        jcmb.rate as "Rate:Currency:120",
        jcmb.amount as "Amount:Currency:200",
        "" as "Sales Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:200"
        FROM `tabIssue` jc
        INNER JOIN `tabIssue Materials Detail` jcmb on jcmb.parent = jc.name
        WHERE jc.docstatus = 0
          AND DATE(jc.opening_date) BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s
UNION ALL
SELECT  jc.name as "Maintenance Job Card:Link/Issue:200",
        jc.property_name  as "Property:Link/Property:200",
        jc.customer  as "Customer:Link/Customer:200",
        jc.opening_date as "Opening Date:Date:120",
        jc.resolution_date as "Resolution Date:Date:120",
        jc.modified_by as "Modified By:Link/User:200",
        jc.status as "Status:Data:120",
        jcb.item as "Item:Link/Item:200",
        jcb.quantity as "Quantity:Float:200",
        jcb.uom as "UOM:Link/UOM:200",
        jcb.rate as "Rate:Currency:120",
        jcb.amount as "Amount:Currency:200",
        jcb.sales_invoice as "Sales Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:200"
        FROM `tabIssue` jc
        INNER JOIN `tabIssue Materials Billed` jcb on jcb.parent = jc.name
        WHERE jc.docstatus = 1
          AND DATE(jc.opening_date) BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s
ORDER BY "Opening Date", "Maintenance Job Card", "Sales Invoice", "Item"

query:
SELECT  p.type AS "Property Type:Data:0",
        l.property AS "Property:Link/Property:0",
        l.name "Lease No.:Data:0",
        p.bedroom AS "BHK:Data:0",
        p.builtup_area AS "Builtup Area:Data:0",
        p.carpet_area AS "Carper Area:Data:0",
        p.unit_owner AS "Unit Owner:Link/Customer:0",
        l.lease_customer AS "Lease Customer:Link/Customer:0",
        l.customer as "POS Customer:Link/Customer:0",
        l.lease_date as "Lease Date:Date:0",
        l.start_date as "Lease Start:Date:0",
        l.end_date as "Lease End:Date:0",
        if(l.signed_agreement_received = 1, "Yes", " ") AS "Agreement Status:Data:0",
        if(l.stamp_duty_paid_by_tenant = 1, "Yes", " ") AS "Stamp Duty Status:Data:0",
        l.security_deposit_currency as "Security Deposit Currency:Data:0",
        l.security_deposit as "Security Amount:Currency/Security Deposit Currency:0",
        ld1.frequency AS "Rent Frequency:Data:0",
        ld1.currency_code AS "Rent Currency:Data:0",
        ld1.amount as "Rent Amount:Currency/Rent Currency:0",
        ld2.frequency AS "Service Charge Frequency:Data:0",
        ld2.currency_code AS "Service Charge Currency:Data:0",
        ld2.amount as "Service Charge Amount:Currency/Service Charge Currency:0"
FROM `tabLease` l left join `tabProperty` p on l.property = p.name
                  left join `tabLease Item` ld1 on l.name = ld1.parent and (ld1.lease_item in ('Commercial Rent', 'Residential Rent') or ld1.lease_item like 'Parking Slot%%')
                  left join `tabLease Item` ld2 on l.name = ld2.parent and ld2.lease_item in ('Service Charge - Commercial','Service Charge - Residential')
WHERE p.type LIKE concat("%%", IF(%(property_type)s = " " , "", %(property_type)s), "%%")

name: Withholding Tax Summary on Sales (Properties)
query:
SELECT si.posting_date as "Date:Date:",
       si.customer_name as "Customer:Link/Customer:", 
       sii.item_name as "Perticulars:Data:", 
       si.name as "Voucher No:Link/Sales Invoice:", 
       si.lease as "Property:Link/Lease:",
       concat_ws(' and ', sii.service_start_date, sii.service_end_date) as "Period:Data:", 
       sii.base_net_amount as "Amount:Currency:", 
       sii.base_net_amount * (sii.withholding_tax_rate/100) as "Withholding Tax:Currency:",
       si.tra_control_number as "Contol Number:Data:",
       si.witholding_tax_certificate_number as "Contol Number:Data:",
       if(si.tax_id,si.tax_id,c.tax_id) as "TIN Number:Data:"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON si.name = sii.parent 
INNER JOIN `tabCustomer` c ON si.customer = c.name
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
AND   si.is_return = '0' 
AND   sii.withholding_tax_rate > 0
AND   si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s 
AND   si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s

Maintenance Schedules
query:
SELECT
    ms_sch.scheduled_date as "Schedule Date:Date:120",
	ms_sch.item_code as "Item Code:Link/Item:120",
	ms_sch.item_name as "Item Name::120",
	ms_sch.serial_no as "Serial No::120",
	ms_sch.sales_person as "Sales Person::120",
	ms.customer_name as "Customer:Link/Customer:120",
	ms.address_display as "Customer Address::120",
	ms_item.sales_order as "Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:120",
	ms.company as "Company:Link/Company:120"
	
FROM
	`tabMaintenance Schedule` ms, 
    `tabMaintenance Schedule Detail` ms_sch, 
    `tabMaintenance Schedule Item` ms_item
WHERE
	ms.name = ms_sch.parent and ms.name = ms_item.parent and ms.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY
	ms_sch.scheduled_date asc, ms_sch.item_code asc

query:
select
    po_item.item_code as "Item Code:Link/Item:120",
	po_item.item_name as "Item Name::120",
        po_item.item_group as "Item Group:Link/Item Group:120",
	po_item.description as "Description::150",
	po_item.qty as "Qty:Float:100",
	po_item.uom as "UOM:Link/UOM:80",
	po_item.base_rate as "Rate:Currency:120",
	po_item.base_amount as "Amount:Currency:120",
	po.name as "Purchase Order:Link/Purchase Order:120",
	po.transaction_date as "Transaction Date:Date:140",
	po.supplier as "Supplier:Link/Supplier:130",
        sup.supplier_name as "Supplier Name::150",
	po_item.project as "Project:Link/Project:130",
	ifnull(po_item.received_qty, 0) as "Received Qty:Float:120",
	po.company as "Company:Link/Company:"
from
	`tabPurchase Order` po, `tabPurchase Order Item` po_item, `tabSupplier` sup
where
	po.name = po_item.parent and po.supplier = sup.name and po.docstatus = 1
order by po.name desc

name: Issued Items Against Work Order
query:
select
    ste.work_order as "Work Order:Link/Work Order:120",
    ste.posting_date as "Issue Date:Date:140",
    ste_item.item_code as "Item Code:Link/Item:120",
	ste_item.description as "Description::150",
	ste_item.transfer_qty as "Qty:Float:100",
	ste_item.stock_uom as "UOM:Link/UOM:80",
	ste_item.amount as "Amount:Currency:120",
	ste_item.serial_no as "Serial No:Link/Serial No:80",
	ste_item.s_warehouse as "Source Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:120",
	ste_item.t_warehouse as "Target Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:120",
	wo.production_item as "Finished Goods:Link/Item:120", 
	ste.name as "Stock Entry:Link/Stock Entry:120",
	ste.company as "Company:Link/Company:",
	(select bin.projected_qty from `tabBin` bin 
			where  bin.item_code= ste_item.item_code and bin.warehouse= ste_item.s_warehouse) as "Projected Quantity as Source:Float:200"
from	`tabStock Entry` ste, `tabStock Entry Detail` ste_item, `tabWork Order` wo
where
	ifnull(ste.work_order, '') != '' and ste.name = ste_item.parent 
	and ste.work_order = wo.name and ste.docstatus = 1
	and ste.purpose = 'Material Transfer for Manufacture'
order by ste.posting_date, ste.work_order, ste_item.item_code

name: Sales Partners Commission
query:
SELECT
    sales_partner as "Sales Partner:Link/Sales Partner:220",
	sum(base_net_total) as "Invoiced Amount (Excl. Tax):Currency:220",
	sum(amount_eligible_for_commission) as "Amount Eligible for Commission:Currency:220",
	sum(total_commission) as "Total Commission:Currency:170",
	sum(total_commission)*100/sum(amount_eligible_for_commission) as "Average Commission Rate:Percent:220"
FROM
	`tabSales Invoice`
WHERE
	docstatus = 1 and ifnull(base_net_total, 0) > 0 and ifnull(total_commission, 0) > 0
GROUP BY
	sales_partner
ORDER BY
	"Total Commission:Currency:120"

Requested Items To Be Transferred
query:
select 
    mr.name as "Material Request:Link/Material Request:120",
	mr.transaction_date as "Date:Date:100",
	mr_item.item_code as "Item Code:Link/Item:120",
	mr_item.qty as "Qty:Float:100",
	mr_item.ordered_qty as "Transferred Qty:Float:100", 
	(mr_item.qty - ifnull(mr_item.ordered_qty, 0)) as "Qty to Transfer:Float:100",
	mr_item.item_name as "Item Name::150",
	mr_item.description as "Description::200",
	mr.company as "Company:Link/Company:"
from
	`tabMaterial Request` mr, `tabMaterial Request Item` mr_item
where
	mr_item.parent = mr.name
	and mr.material_request_type in ("Material Transfer", "Material Issue")
	and mr.docstatus = 1
	and mr.status != "Stopped"
	and ifnull(mr_item.ordered_qty, 0) < ifnull(mr_item.qty, 0)
order by mr.transaction_date asc

select
    `tabDelivery Note`.`name` as "Delivery Note:Link/Delivery Note:120",
	`tabDelivery Note`.`customer` as "Customer:Link/Customer:120",
	`tabDelivery Note`.`customer_name` as "Customer Name::150",
	`tabDelivery Note`.`posting_date` as "Date:Date",
	`tabDelivery Note`.`project` as "Project",
	`tabDelivery Note Item`.`item_code` as "Item:Link/Item:120",
	(`tabDelivery Note Item`.`base_amount` - `tabDelivery Note Item`.`billed_amt`*ifnull(`tabDelivery Note`.conversion_rate, 1)) as "Pending Amount:Currency:110",
	`tabDelivery Note Item`.`item_name` as "Item Name::150",
	`tabDelivery Note Item`.`description` as "Description::200",
	`tabDelivery Note`.`company` as "Company:Link/Company:"
from `tabDelivery Note`, `tabDelivery Note Item`
where  
    `tabDelivery Note`.name = `tabDelivery Note Item`.parent 
    and `tabDelivery Note`.docstatus = 1 
    and `tabDelivery Note`.`status` not in ("Stopped", "Closed") 
    and `tabDelivery Note Item`.amount > 0
    and `tabDelivery Note Item`.billed_amt < `tabDelivery Note Item`.amount
order by `tabDelivery Note`.`name` desc

name: Received Items To Be Billed
query:
select
    `tabPurchase Receipt`.`name` as "Purchase Receipt:Link/Purchase Receipt:120",
    `tabPurchase Receipt`.`supplier` as "Supplier:Link/Supplier:120",
	`tabPurchase Receipt`.`supplier_name` as "Supplier Name::150",
	`tabPurchase Receipt`.`posting_date` as "Date:Date",
	`tabPurchase Receipt Item`.`project` as "Project",
	`tabPurchase Receipt Item`.`item_code` as "Item:Link/Item:120",
	(`tabPurchase Receipt Item`.`base_amount` - `tabPurchase Receipt Item`.`billed_amt`*ifnull(`tabPurchase Receipt`.conversion_rate, 1)) as "Pending Amount:Currency:110",
	`tabPurchase Receipt Item`.`item_name` as "Item Name::150",
	`tabPurchase Receipt Item`.`description` as "Description::200",
	`tabPurchase Receipt`.`company` as "Company:Link/Company:"
from `tabPurchase Receipt`, `tabPurchase Receipt Item`
where
    `tabPurchase Receipt`.name = `tabPurchase Receipt Item`.parent 
    and `tabPurchase Receipt`.docstatus = 1 
    and `tabPurchase Receipt`.status != "Closed" 
    and `tabPurchase Receipt Item`.amount > 0
    and `tabPurchase Receipt Item`.billed_amt < `tabPurchase Receipt Item`.amount
order by `tabPurchase Receipt`.`name` desc

name: Material Requests for which Supplier Quotations are not created
query:
select 
    mr.name as "Material Request:Link/Material Request:120",
    mr.transaction_date as "Date:Date:100",
	mr_item.item_code as "Item Code:Link/Item:120",
	mr_item.qty as "Qty:Float:100",
	mr_item.item_name as "Item Name::150",
	mr_item.description as "Description::200",
	mr.company as "Company:Link/Company:"
from
	`tabMaterial Request` mr, `tabMaterial Request Item` mr_item
where
	mr_item.parent = mr.name
	and mr.material_request_type = "Purchase"
	and mr.docstatus = 1
	and mr.status != "Stopped"
	and not exists(select name from `tabSupplier Quotation Item` where material_request=mr.name)
order by mr.transaction_date asc
report_name: Material Requests for which Supplier Quotations are not created

name: Open Work Orders
query:
SELECT
  `tabWork Order`.name as "Work Order:Link/Work Order:200",
  `tabWork Order`.creation as "Date:Date:120",
  `tabWork Order`.production_item as "Item:Link/Item:150",
  `tabWork Order`.qty as "To Produce:Int:100",
  `tabWork Order`.produced_qty as "Produced:Int:100",
  `tabWork Order`.company as "Company:Link/Company:"
FROM
  `tabWork Order`
WHERE
  `tabWork Order`.docstatus=1
  AND ifnull(`tabWork Order`.produced_qty,0) < `tabWork Order`.qty
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT name from `tabStock Entry` where work_order =`tabWork Order`.name)

name: Work Orders in Progress
query:
SELECT
  `tabWork Order`.name as "Work Order:Link/Work Order:200",
  `tabWork Order`.creation as "Date:Date:120",
  `tabWork Order`.production_item as "Item:Link/Item:150",
  `tabWork Order`.qty as "To Produce:Int:100",
  `tabWork Order`.produced_qty as "Produced:Int:100",
  `tabWork Order`.company as "Company:Link/Company:"
FROM
  `tabWork Order`
WHERE
  `tabWork Order`.docstatus=1
  AND `tabWork Order`.status != 'Stopped'
  AND ifnull(`tabWork Order`.produced_qty,0) < `tabWork Order`.qty
  AND EXISTS (SELECT name from `tabStock Entry` where work_order =`tabWork Order`.name)

name: Completed Work Orders
query:
SELECT
  `tabWork Order`.name as "Work Order:Link/Work Order:200",
  `tabWork Order`.creation as "Date:Date:120",
  `tabWork Order`.production_item as "Item:Link/Item:150",
  `tabWork Order`.qty as "To Produce:Int:100",
  `tabWork Order`.produced_qty as "Produced:Int:100",
  `tabWork Order`.company as "Company:Link/Company:"
FROM
  `tabWork Order`
WHERE
  `tabWork Order`.docstatus=1
  AND ifnull(`tabWork Order`.produced_qty,0) >= `tabWork Order`.qty

query:
SELECT
    tabBin.item_code as "Item:Link/Item:120",
    tabBin.warehouse as "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:120",
    tabBin.actual_qty as "Actual:Float:90",
    tabBin.indented_qty as "Requested:Float:90",
    tabBin.reserved_qty as "Reserved:Float:90",
    tabBin.ordered_qty as "Ordered:Float:90",
    tabBin.projected_qty as "Projected:Float:90"
FROM
    tabBin, tabItem
WHERE
    tabBin.item_code = tabItem.name
   AND tabBin.projected_qty < 0
ORDER BY
    tabBin.projected_qty ASC
